result.question: What sin leads to Jeroboam's family's downfall?

readings.answer: Appointing and ordaining anyone as priests for the high places
readings.support: he appointed priests for the high places from every class of people. He ordained anyone who desired to be a priest of the high places | this was the sin of the house of Jeroboam that led to its extermination and destruction

readings.answer: Not repenting of his evil ways
readings.support: did not repent of his evil ways | this was the sin of the house of Jeroboam that led to its extermination and destruction

assessments.reason: The passage states he appointed priests for the high places from every class and ordained anyone who desired, and then says “this was the sin … that led to its extermination,” which matches consecrating anyone as priests.
“This was the sin … that led to its extermination” refers specifically to the appointing/ordaining of anyone as priests, not the earlier clause that he did not repent of his evil ways.

result.reason: Verse 34 explicitly identifies the practice of ordaining anyone as priests as the sin that led to the house of Jeroboam’s destruction.
